title: مشروع مصعد الفضاء خيال علمي أم حلم قابل للتنفيذ؟

en.title: The space elevator: science fiction or a feasible dream?
en.excerpt: An interview with Dr. Hanna Sabat on a space elevator that could cut the cost of sending payloads to space from 20,000 dollars per kilogram to just 100.
en.body:
An interview with Dr. Hanna Sabat about a project for an elevator extending 35 km into space
that cuts the cost of carrying space payloads from 20,000 dollars per kilogram to just 100 dollars.. fantasy or a feasible idea?
